provenance.verification: The pinned git archive digest and all 67 source inventory entries match the tracked source manifest, current exported fixture, and retained prior worker source copy. The wrapper matches that archive. Every extracted XML test ID equals a prior worker test ID for the same module and target; standalone worker results equal the retained aggregate evidence.
limitations: Retained XML reports and worker results were not cryptographically sealed together with source bytes at invocation time. Their digests pin the files inspected for this manifest; provenance also relies on retained harness records and logs.
No baseline was rerun. This manifest covers the 2038 selected JVM test identities at the pinned fixture commit, not general discovery or Native parity.

extraction.identitySource: Exactly one unique-id: line in each direct testcase/system-out; preserve the complete ID verbatim, including all nested [test:] segments.
extraction.includedTests: Require a Kotest engine/spec ID containing /[test:, no failure/error/skipped elements, and no duplicate IDs within a module/target. Require exact set equality with prior worker tests[].id and complete passing worker counts.
extraction.exclusionRule: Exclude only the exact listed FlatFunSpec helper-container ID, which has no /[test: segment; require exactly one such entry across the reference XML files. Reject any other non-test entry.
extraction.canonicalTestsEncoding: UTF-8 JSON of tests only, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), no trailing newline
